command:. .gnomish/lib/task-change.sh
since=$(git log --format='%H %s' | awk '$2 == "gnomish:" && $3 == "round" && $4 !~ /^implement#/ { print $1; exit }')
start=$(git log --format='%H %s' | awk '$2 == "gnomish:" && $3 == "task" && $4 == "started" { print $1; exit }')
[ -n "$since" ] || since=$(git rev-parse "$start^" 2>/dev/null || git merge-base HEAD origin/main)
changed=$({ git diff --name-only "$since"; git ls-files -o --exclude-standard; } | sort -u | grep -v '^\.gnomish-task/' || true)
forbidden=$(printf '%s\n' "$changed" | grep -E '^(openspec/|temporary-docs/|\.gnomish/|\.github/|\.claude/|docs/adr/|CLAUDE\.md$)' | grep -vxF "$change/tasks.md" | grep -v "^$reports/handoff/" || true)
[ -z "$forbidden" ] || { echo "$forbidden"; echo "the implement stage edits only packages/, docs/ outside docs/adr/, the checkboxes of $change/tasks.md and $reports/handoff/ - put changes to these paths into a handoff patch (see .gnomish/stages/specify/handoff.md) and restore the files above with: git checkout $since -- <file>"; exit 1; }
dependencies=$(printf '%s\n' "$changed" | grep -E '(^|/)(package\.json|pnpm-lock\.yaml)$' || true)
if [ -n "$dependencies" ] && ! grep -qiE 'pnpm add|dependenc|package\.json' "$change/tasks.md"; then echo "$dependencies"; echo "tasks.md asks for no dependency or package.json change - restore the files above with: git checkout $since -- <file>"; exit 1; fi

command:. .gnomish/lib/task-change.sh
for patch in "$reports"/handoff/*.patch; do
  [ -e "$patch" ] || continue
  git apply --check "$patch" || { echo "$patch does not apply to the branch - regenerate it as .gnomish/stages/specify/handoff.md describes"; exit 1; }
done
if grep -qE '^- H[0-9]+' "$change/tasks.md" && [ ! -f "$reports/handoff/README.md" ]; then
  echo "tasks.md lists handoff items under Human follow-up but $reports/handoff/README.md is missing"; exit 1
fi

The proposal UI States Matrix row is 'location list loading | the row skeleton of the main page; the input already works', and ticked task 9.5 requires 'row skeleton while the list loads' in ListConverterView.tsx. In the code, useUnixTimeConverter returns loadStatus (packages/client/src/controller/unixTime/useUnixTimeConverter.ts:119), but UnixTimeConverterPage.tsx drops it. ConverterViewProps (views/unixTimeConverter/converterViewDefinition.ts:23-28) has no load-status field, and ListConverterView.tsx always renders the rows. Nothing under views/unixTimeConverter, tools or presenter/unixTime references loadStatus, a skeleton or loading. Fix: pass the load status to the converter view, render the main page's row skeleton (the shared skeleton block) in place of the rows while the list loads, keep the input working, and add a component test plus a BDD scenario for the loading state.

findings.message: UnixTimeConverterPage.tsx:54 sets `isListLoading={loadStatus !== LocationsStatus.READY}`, but LocationsStatus has only READY and UNREADABLE (controller/locationsContext.ts:14-17) and the list loads synchronously (LocationsProvider.tsx:103-107). The only status that reaches the skeleton branch of ListConverterView.tsx:56 is an unreadable list, so the page shows the row skeleton forever instead of the device-zone row. This breaks the spec requirement 'Converter rows' of unix-time-converter: 'With an empty or unreadable list it MUST show one row for the device time zone. While the list loads it shows the row skeleton.' Pass the loading flag only for a real loading state, and let UNREADABLE fall through to the presented rows (one device-zone row).

No test covers the unreadable-list state of the converter. The unit BDD scenario 'The location list is loading' (unix_time_converter_loading_unit.steps.tsx:28-37) forces `isListLoading` on by wrapping the view, so it checks a prop rather than page behaviour. No page, view or BDD test opens the converter with an UNREADABLE location list and checks that exactly one device-zone row is shown. The test helper renderConverterView.tsx:83 copies the same `loadStatus !== LocationsStatus.READY` logic and hides the bug. Add a test (page-level or BDD) for the unreadable list that checks for the single device-zone row.

findings.message: Empty-input hint is never rendered. The unix-time-converter spec delta, 'Converter messages', says: 'An empty input shows the first text as a hint, not as an error.' The proposal's state table says 'empty input | hint in place of a message', and task 9.4 asks for `ConverterInputField.tsx` with 'name, hint, message by `aria-describedby`'. presentConverter.ts:132 fills `input.hint` (unixTime.inputHint), but packages/client/src/views/unixTimeConverter/list/ConverterInputField.tsx never reads `input.hint` (no placeholder or described-by text), so an empty input shows nothing. No component or BDD test covers the empty-input hint. Render the hint (for example as the described-by text when there is no message) and add a test.

The row-skeleton loading state is faked. packages/client/src/tools/unixTimeConverter/UnixTimeConverterPage.tsx:54 passes `isListLoading={false}` as a constant and ignores the `loadStatus` returned by useUnixTimeConverter. LocationsStatus has only READY/UNREADABLE, so ListConverterView's skeleton branch can never run in production. The unit BDD scenario 'The location list is loading' (unix_time_converter_loading_unit.feature, @FR9) only passes because its step wraps the view and forces `isListLoading` on, so it tests a prop, not app behaviour, against the criterion 'Tests assert behaviour, not implementation details'. Either derive the flag from a real loading state, or drop the dead prop and have the scenario check the real loading state (ToolHost's ViewSkeleton while the converter chunk loads, which matches the spec's 'While the list loads it shows the row skeleton').

findings.message: Converter rows: the unix-time-converter delta (Requirement 'Converter rows') says 'While the list loads it shows the row skeleton.', the proposal's UI States Matrix row is 'location list loading | the row skeleton of the main page; the input already works', and ticked task 9.5 asks for 'row skeleton while the list loads' in ListConverterView.tsx. Not implemented: useUnixTimeConverter.ts:119 returns loadStatus but UnixTimeConverterPage.tsx:34 drops it, and ListConverterView.tsx renders converter.rows whatever the load status is. The scenario 'The converter page is still loading' (unix_time_converter_loading_unit.feature, tagged @FR9 @UX1) only shows ToolHost's Suspense page-loading skeleton, so no test covers the state where the location list is still loading. Show the row skeleton (input still usable) while loadStatus is loading, and add a test that renders the converter with a location list that is still loading.

useConverterCommands.ts:43 and :106-113 (showOnMainPage) declares `const MILLISECONDS_PER_MINUTE_START_FLOOR = 60_000;` and rounds the moment down to the minute inside the controller. The constant repeats MILLISECONDS_PER_MINUTE = 60_000 from @/constants (constants/clock.ts:2); code-style.md: 'Is any value repeated in 2+ places? → Must be a constant'. Rounding to the minute start is time math, and glossary.md says 'Time math, day periods, the reference day and every rule of the model → src/model/, owned once, pure' and 'the second layer calls the owner; it does not recompute'. Put the rounding in a function in src/model/unixTime (using MILLISECONDS_PER_MINUTE or Temporal round with smallestUnit 'minute', roundingMode 'floor'), test it there, and call it from the controller.
